prompt_text:
Task: Federated Login Flow

Write code that fetches and normalizes federated user profile claims using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Google Identity Platform OIDC:
  Service: Google Identity Platform
  SDK: REST / firebase-admin
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: signInWithIdp, OIDC provider config
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/identity-platform/docs/web/oidc

Option 2 — Alibaba Cloud IDaaS EIAM OIDC:
  Service: IDaaS EIAM OIDC
  SDK: OIDC REST
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_IDAAS_ISSUER, ALIBABA_IDAAS_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/idaas/eiam/developer-reference/integrate-sso-with-oidc

Option 3 — IBM App ID Federation:
  Service: IBM Cloud App ID federation
  SDK: requests
  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: IBM_APPID_CLIENT_ID, IBM_APPID_CLIENT_SECRET
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/appid?topic=appid-enterprise

Option 4 — Auth0:
  Service: Auth0 Authentication API
  SDK: auth0-python / OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, oauth/token, userinfo
  Setup hints: AUTH0_DOMAIN, AUTH0_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://auth0.com/docs/api/authentication

Option 5 — Cognito Hosted UI Federation:
  Service: Amazon Cognito federation
  SDK: boto3 + OIDC
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: authorize, token, userinfo
  Setup hints: COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cognito/latest/developerguide/cognito-user-pools-identity-provider.html

Option 6 — Microsoft Entra OIDC:
  Service: Microsoft identity platform
  SDK: msal
  Interface: sdk_or_protocol
  Documented operations: get_authorization_request_url, acquire_token_by_authorization_code
  Setup hints: AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import json
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
from urllib.parse import urlencode

import requests

AUTH0_DOMAIN = os.getenv("AUTH0_DOMAIN")
AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET")
AUTH0_AUDIENCE = os.getenv("AUTH0_AUDIENCE")
AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI = os.getenv("AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost/callback")
AUTH0_SCOPE = os.getenv("AUTH0_SCOPE", "openid profile email")

_PROVIDER_USERINFO_PATH = "/userinfo"
_PROVIDER_TOKEN_PATH = "/oauth/token"
_PROVIDER_AUTHORIZE_PATH = "/authorize"


@dataclass
class FederatedUserProfile:
    sub: str
    email: Optional[str] = None
    email_verified: Optional[bool] = None
    name: Optional[str] = None
    given_name: Optional[str] = None
    family_name: Optional[str] = None
    picture: Optional[str] = None
    locale: Optional[str] = None
    issuer: Optional[str] = None
    raw: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None


def _ensure_config() -> None:
    if not AUTH0_DOMAIN:
        raise ValueError("AUTH0_DOMAIN is required")
    if not AUTH0_CLIENT_ID:
        raise ValueError("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID is required")
    if not AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET:
        raise ValueError("AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET is required")


def build_authorize_url(state: str, nonce: Optional[str] = None, response_type: str = "code") -> str:
    _ensure_config()
    params = {
        "response_type": response_type,
        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
        "redirect_uri": AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI,
        "scope": AUTH0_SCOPE,
        "state": state,
    }
    if AUTH0_AUDIENCE:
        params["audience"] = AUTH0_AUDIENCE
    if nonce:
        params["nonce"] = nonce
    return f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}{_PROVIDER_AUTHORIZE_PATH}?{urlencode(params)}"


def exchange_code_for_tokens(code: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    _ensure_config()
    url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}{_PROVIDER_TOKEN_PATH}"
    payload = {
        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
        "client_id": AUTH0_CLIENT_ID,
        "client_secret": AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET,
        "code": code,
        "redirect_uri": AUTH0_REDIRECT_URI,
    }
    resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


def fetch_userinfo(access_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    _ensure_config()
    url = f"https://{AUTH0_DOMAIN}{_PROVIDER_USERINFO_PATH}"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}"}
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return resp.json()


def normalize_federated_claims(claims: Dict[str, Any]) -> FederatedUserProfile:
    return FederatedUserProfile(
        sub=str(claims.get("sub", "")),
        email=claims.get("email"),
        email_verified=claims.get("email_verified"),
        name=claims.get("name"),
        given_name=claims.get("given_name"),
        family_name=claims.get("family_name"),
        picture=claims.get("picture"),
        locale=claims.get("locale"),
        issuer=claims.get("iss"),
        raw=claims,
    )


def fetch_and_normalize_user_profile(access_token: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    claims = fetch_userinfo(access_token)
    profile = normalize_federated_claims(claims)
    return {
        "sub": profile.sub,
        "email": profile.email,
        "email_verified": profile.email_verified,
        "name": profile.name,
        "given_name": profile.given_name,
        "family_name": profile.family_name,
        "picture": profile.picture,
        "locale": profile.locale,
        "issuer": profile.issuer,
        "raw": profile.raw,
    }
